info.title: OpenELIS Global REST API
info.description: OpenELIS Global 2 is an open-source laboratory information system (LIS/LIMS) for clinical and public-health labs. Its Java/Spring web application serves a JSON REST API under the `/rest/**` (and a few `/api/**`) paths of its servlet context `/api/OpenELIS-Global`, and it is deployed alongside a HAPI FHIR R4 store that holds the same lab work as FHIR resources (Patient, ServiceRequest, Specimen, Observation, DiagnosticReport, Task). The OpenFn `openelis` adaptor exposes only a generic http namespace (`http.get` / `http.post` / `http.request`) and builds every request as `{baseUrl}/api/OpenELIS-Global/rest/{path}` with HTTP Basic auth, so `http.get('fhir/ServiceRequest')` reaches the webapp FHIR passthrough at `/rest/fhir/ServiceRequest`.

servers.description: OpenELIS Global webapp (servlet context `/api/OpenELIS-Global` behind the bundled nginx proxy). Serves every `/rest/**` and `/api/**` path below. This is the base the openelis adaptor targets.

Companion HAPI FHIR R4 store (the `external-fhir-api` service, `org.openelisglobal.fhirstore.uri`). Serves the `/fhir/**` paths below with full create/read/update/delete; the webapp proxies read-only queries of the same resources under `/rest/fhir/**`.

Bundle.description: FHIR R4 Bundle — the envelope FHIR search results, transactions and batches use.

total.description: Total matches for a searchset Bundle.

BundleEntry.description: One entry of a FHIR Bundle.

fullUrl.description: Absolute URL of the entry resource.

CapabilityStatement.description: FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement describing the endpoint and the interactions it supports.

Error.description: Error payload. OpenELIS Global returns either a Spring Boot error envelope (`timestamp`/`status`/`error`/`message`/`path`) or a `{ "error": "..." }` map, depending on the controller.

FhirResource.description: Any FHIR R4 resource. Only the elements every resource carries are declared; the rest of the resource body varies by `resourceType` and is passed through.

OperationOutcome.description: FHIR R4 OperationOutcome — the error/status resource a FHIR endpoint returns.
